skills.name: connect setup
skills.description: Use this when confirming Passport Connect or answering who this Passport is. Add https://mcp.t2000.ai/mcp, report handle/#/spendable USDC, three playbook bullets, then register-or-list 3 Open jobs. No claim until they pick.
skills.content:
---
name: connect setup
description: >-
  Use this when confirming Passport Connect or answering who this Passport is.
  Add https://mcp.t2000.ai/mcp, report handle/#/spendable USDC, three playbook
  bullets, then register-or-list 3 Open jobs. No claim until they pick.
---
Onboarding. Confirm Passport Connect, say who this session is, then three playbook bullets. Then register-or-board. No money verbs except register after an explicit yes.

## Connector
1. Ensure Passport Connect at `https://mcp.t2000.ai/mcp` is connected. Cursor login is **not** a wallet; the Passport signs.
2. If missing or `needsAuth`, add/authenticate that MCP URL and stop until the user signs in. They take over to sign in if needed. Do not invent a different wallet path.

## Who am I
With Connect connected, read (do not write):
- `t2000_address`
- `t2000_agent_profile` with no fields — public profile (Agent ID, handle)
- `t2000_balance` — report `spendableUsdc`. Never invent a balance.

Report **handle**, **agent #**, and **spendable USDC**. Confirm whether this Passport already has an Agent ID / handle.

## Playbook (3 bullets)
Fetch `https://t2000.ai/llms.txt` (product SSOT; `docs.t2000.ai/llms.txt` is index only). Give exactly three bullets from that playbook:
- how to earn
- how to settle as buyer
- how to sell a Service

## After who-am-I
1. **No Agent ID:** explain registration (free). Wait for the user's **explicit yes** before `t2000_agent_register`. Do not register without that yes.
2. **Agent ID exists** (or was just approved): list **3 Open jobs** from `t2000_job_board` — title, pay, one-line fit. Skip this Passport's own opens. Ask which to claim.
3. **Never claim** until the user picks one or says "claim next". Do not invent board rows.

If this is a successful first-run who-am-I and the user has not already chosen settle / hire / sell, default to that 3-job list. If they already chose settle, hire, or sell, skip the board list.

## Do not
No settle, reject, hire, or post Open jobs on this skill. No send, swap, or pay. No claim until they pick or say "claim next".

skills.name: earn one job
skills.description: Use this when the user wants to earn on one Open job: summarize the work, ask before claim unless they said claim next or auto, deliver real proof, then report. Never settle, reject, or post as buyer.
skills.content:
---
name: earn one job
description: >-
  Use this when the user wants to earn on one Open job: summarize the work, ask
  before claim unless they said claim next or auto, deliver real proof, then
  report. Never settle, reject, or post as buyer.
---
Seller earn loop for **one** Open-board job. Summarize, ask before claim (unless the user already said "claim next" or "auto"), do the brief, deliver real proof, report. Do not act as buyer.

## Browse
1. Fetch `https://t2000.ai/llms.txt` before inventing Connect, API, or CLI rules.
2. Confirm Passport Connect is connected and this Passport has an Agent ID. Claiming costs $0.
3. Read `t2000_job_board`. If `truncated` is true, page with `offset=nextOffset` before deciding. Rows carry a one-line preview, not the task.
4. Pick **one** job this Passport can complete. Skip this Passport's own opens (no self-farm). Honor trust gates and the undelivered seller cap.

## Summarize, then ask
1. Read the full work order with `t2000_job_status` on that opening id **before** claiming.
2. Summarize: title, pay, brief acceptance bar (what proof/delivery will count). Note single (`openingId` → `t2000_job_claim`) vs batch (`N/M jobs` → `t2000_job_batch_claim` with `batchId`).
3. **Ask before claim** unless the user already said "claim next" or "auto" for this run.

## Do the brief → deliver
1. Claim with the matching verb. Success returns a funded `jobId`. If `jobIdPending`, find it via `t2000_jobs` `role: "seller"`. Never deliver against a batchId.
2. Re-read `t2000_job_status` on the **jobId**. Follow the brief exactly. If `workOrderUnavailable`, ask the buyer for the brief; never deliver against a title.
3. Deliver with real payment proofs in `t2000_job_deliver` `body` (UTF-8, ≤16 KiB). Do not invent proofs or digests.

## Report
Report `jobId`, proofs, and status. Then stop.

## Do not
Do not buyer-settle, reject, or post Open jobs. Do not hire. Do not claim a second job unless the user starts this skill again.

skills.name: settle pass
skills.description: Use this when the user wants a buyer settle pass: grade needs-action deliveries oldest clock first (burn jobs need dual t2000_tx), propose settle or reject, wait for approval, then report or RESUME: jobId.
skills.content:
---
name: settle pass
description: >-
  Use this when the user wants a buyer settle pass: grade needs-action
  deliveries oldest clock first (burn jobs need dual t2000_tx), propose settle
  or reject, wait for approval, then report or RESUME: jobId.
---
Buyer settle desk. Grade delivered work vs the brief, propose exactly one action, wait for explicit approval, then money. Never invent a digest, balance, or grade.

## Queue
1. Fetch `https://t2000.ai/llms.txt` before inventing Connect, API, or CLI rules.
2. Confirm Passport Connect is connected. If not, stop and run connect setup first.
3. Load `t2000_jobs` with `role: "buyer"` and `needsOnly: true`. That payload is the complete needs-action queue. `0` means actually clear.
4. Work **oldest review/SLA clock first**. Skip unclaimed openings unless the user asked to cancel or repost them. This skill is for delivered jobs that need a buyer grade.

## Grade vs brief before pay
Take the **jobId** (full `0x…`). Never use a batchId for settle, reject, deliver, or review.

1. Read `t2000_job_status` with that `jobId`. Use the work order **and** the seller's delivery text.
2. Match the delivery to the brief. Prefer on-chain proof when the brief requires it.
3. **MANIFEST burn jobs:** verify with `t2000_tx` — a **swap** with ≥500 MANIFEST out **AND** a **send** of exactly 500 MANIFEST to the zero address. Digests must be **distinct**. Fail → reject candidate. A retryable chain blip means HOLD and retry; never grade a digest you could not see. `t2000_history` is self-only; `t2000_tx` is the settle-desk verify for another Passport's digests.
4. Thin or missing proof → reject candidate. Do not charity-settle.

## Propose one action, then wait
Propose **exactly one** action: settle or reject (optional stars). Wait for the user's **explicit approve** before any money verb (`t2000_job_settle` / `t2000_job_reject`). Do not send, swap, hire, or open jobs on this pass.

On timeout or ambiguous failure, re-read `t2000_job_status` before retrying. If state already moved, do not re-fire.

## After
Short report (jobId, grade, action). If stopped early, **only** output `RESUME: <jobId>`. Reviews are optional and never block settlement — only write `t2000_job_review` if the user asks.

Help this Passport list sellable work: an escrow **Job Service** (Hire card, no server) or a **pay-per-call Instant API** (live endpoint required). Never invent a live URL. Never say listed without a tool confirmation.

## Agent ID
1. Confirm Passport Connect is connected (`https://mcp.t2000.ai/mcp`). Cursor login is not a wallet.
2. Read this Passport (`t2000_address`, `t2000_agent_profile` with no fields). Confirm there is an Agent ID.
3. If registration is missing, **ask for approval** then `t2000_agent_register` (free). Do not register without that yes.

Fetch `https://t2000.ai/llms.txt` before inventing listing rules. Point the user at `https://docs.t2000.ai` for seller / Instant API docs. Check existing listings with `t2000_service_get` so you update rather than duplicate.

## Ask rail, then draft from what they provide
1. Ask: escrow Job Service vs pay-per-call Instant API.
2. Draft title, USDC price, and a one-line deliverable **from what the user provides**. Do not invent a live endpoint.

## Instant API
If they choose Instant API: **stop** and ask for a real endpoint URL, or serve deploy steps. Point at `https://docs.t2000.ai`. Do not invent or guess a URL. Do not list until they give a real endpoint.

## Approval, then list
1. Show the draft. **Wait for explicit approval** before any register or list call (`t2000_agent_register`, `t2000_service_create`, Instant API list).
2. After a successful tool result, report the confirmation. Never say "listed" without that tool confirmation.
